# SenselessMethodDuplication

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Unused](/rules/#unused) · PhpStorm name: `SenselessMethodDuplicationInspection`

A child class method whose body is a copy of the inherited method's body is
dead weight: if the visibility is the same the override can simply be
deleted; if only the visibility differs, the override should delegate to
`parent::` instead of duplicating the code.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{43,52} [Before]
<?php
class Repo
{
    protected function load($id)
    {
        $row = ['id' => $id];
        return strtoupper(json_encode($row));
    }

    protected function save($row, $flag)
    {
        $this->log($row);
    }

    protected function count()
    {
        return 1;
    }

    protected function secret()
    {
        return $this->hidden();
    }

    private function hidden()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public function log($x)
    {
        echo $x;
    }
}

class MiddleRepo extends Repo {}

class UserRepo extends MiddleRepo
{
    /**
     * Copied from Repo.
     */
    protected function load($key)
    {
        // same code, different comments
        $row = ['id' => $id];

        /** stray doc block */
        return strtoupper(json_encode( $row ));
    }

    public function save($row, $flag)
    {
        $this->log($row);
    }

    protected function count()
    {
        return 2;
    }

    protected function secret()
    {
        return $this->hidden();
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
class Repo
{
    protected function load($id)
    {
        $row = ['id' => $id];
        return strtoupper(json_encode($row));
    }

    protected function save($row, $flag)
    {
        $this->log($row);
    }

    protected function count()
    {
        return 1;
    }

    protected function secret()
    {
        return $this->hidden();
    }

    private function hidden()
    {
        return 0;
    }

    public function log($x)
    {
        echo $x;
    }
}

class MiddleRepo extends Repo {}

class UserRepo extends MiddleRepo
{
    public function save($row, $flag)
    {
        parent::save($row, $flag);
    }

    protected function count()
    {
        return 2;
    }

    protected function secret()
    {
        return $this->hidden();
    }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 43: Method &#39;load&#39; duplicates the inherited implementation; remove it.</li>
<li>line 52: Method &#39;save&#39; duplicates the inherited implementation; delegate to parent::save() instead.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MAX_METHOD_SIZE` | int | `20` | Methods with more top-level statements than this are skipped. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "SenselessMethodDuplication": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "MAX_METHOD_SIZE": 20
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore SenselessMethodDuplication

/**
 * @noinspection SenselessMethodDuplicationInspection
 */
```
